content: We frame this problem as a Question Answering (QA) task by generating questions using templates. We base the QA model on pointer-generator networks BIBREF9 augmented with Co-Attentions BIBREF10. In addition, we develop models combining QA and Information Extraction frameworks using multi-decoder (one each for dosage and frequency) architecture.
